title: Vulkar Wraith
extract:
The Vulkar Wraith is the Wraith variant of the  Vulkar, featuring higher damage, fire rate, and magazine size.
This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Three zoom modes:
First zoom has 2.5x zoom distance and +35% headshot damage.
Second zoom has 4.0x zoom distance and +55% headshot damage.
Third zoom has 8.0x zoom distance and +70% headshot damage.
Staggers most enemies with every hit.
Can use the Vulkar-exclusive  Lasting Purity and  Meticulous Aim mods.
Purity effect from  Lasting Purity may cause a screen shake, disrupting aiming.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Third highest base damage of all sniper rifles behind  Lanka and  Vectis Prime, and second highest damage of all hit-scan sniper rifles behind Vectis Prime.
Low recoil.
Pinpoint accuracy while zoomed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for headshots.
Innate 1 meter punch through.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average fire rate (2.00 attacks/sec)
Above average total damage (273)
Very high ammo max (72)
Above average status chance (25.00%)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.40x))
Disadvantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).
Slow reload speed.
Inaccurate when fired from the hip, bullets may widely spread when fired.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low active falloff slope (400.0m/%)
Low crit chance (20.00%)
Below average sustained DPS (374.4)
Very low ammo pickup (15)
Very low accuracy (0.00° to 15.00°)
Below average reload speed (3.00 s)
Very low crit multiplier (2.00x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Vulkar Wraith (Normal Attack), compared to  Vulkar (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage per projectile (273.00 vs. 225.00)
Higher  Impact damage ( 245.7 vs.  180)
Lower  Puncture damage ( 27.3 vs.  33.8)
Lower  Slash damage ( 0 vs.  11.2)
Higher total damage (273 vs. 225)
Higher average damage per tap (327.6 vs. 270)
Higher burst DPS (655.2 vs. 405)
Higher sustained DPS (374.4 vs. 231.42)
Higher fire rate (2.00 attacks/sec vs. 1.50 attacks/sec)
Larger magazine (8 vs. 6)
Higher Mastery Rank required (7 vs. 3)
Lower disposition (●●●●● (1.40x) vs. ●●●●● (1.45x))

Acquisition
The Vulkar Wraith is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  300,000 and  450. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
The weapon can be traded, but only for unranked copies without Forma and Orokin Catalyst installed. The trading recipient must also have a Mastery Rank of at least 7.

History
This weapon was first awarded from Operation: Shadow Debt to players who defeated the final challenger, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Notes
Requires only 2 shots to activate its Shot Combo Counter, giving it an immediate 1.5x total damage bonus on the first hit if Multishot mods like  Split Chamber trigger a 2nd shot that also lands on the target.
